	Workflow and tips 1. Smart Chassis is a new automation tool in One Config Advanced building with intelligence running compatible storage backplane cable kit without manual selection process from configurator user. Thus, controller Cable Kits selection is not required. When “Top Selling Smart Chassis Combinations” the system will automatically load the essential Cable Kits in later BOM section2. If required, the pre-view of Share Option Menu will be available, with toggling “Default Setting Recommendation”. Toggle again to unlock Smart Chassis default setting, and user can return to the beginning and start the selection3. Recommend following the sequence for key component upfront selection.  a. Top Selling Smart Chassis Combinations:This section offers pre-configured, popular Smart Chassis options. Selecting a combination will automatically populate the preset options for that configuration. Users can make further adjustments after applying the combination.  b. Network Cable Tracking SKUs (where applicable): Choosing the networking card cable type going to be at field.    AOC cabling for high-performance networking cards has higher power and cooling requirements (Auto Defaulted).     DAC cabling for high-speed, cost-effective, and low-latency requirements. Selected when a high-performance Network card is not needed and with only 1Gb or 10/25Gb card(s) installed.  c. Front cage/storage configuration. Choices of front cage enablement kit, SKUs variates from CTO server.  d. Hardware/storage controller. Choices of HPE Compute MR Gen11 Controllers.4. If selecting options manually in the Smart Chassis category, one or multiple set(s) of Smart Chassis Result will be presented, please confirm the final Smart Chassis selection with select qty 1 to the ideal Smart Chassis.5. It is not recommended to use Ad-Hoc function in Smart Chassis section/page.
